reference_method: V8 crops and scan page were manually transcribed and visually checked from source renders. The 2011 income statement was manually transcribed, visually reviewed and key figures cross-checked against the issuer annual report. The two 2011 balance sheets were transcribed with PDF text-layer assistance and visually checked.
limitations: Fourteen paired regions from six PDFs, including three pages from one third-party Vietnamese financial scan packet. The 2011 balance-sheet references used source PDF text-layer assistance; the financial scan is a single packet and cannot establish representative Vietnamese OCR quality. The v8 regions remain English-heavy and include one born-digital Vietnamese balance-sheet table. Cell-string presence ignores spatial row/column association; coordinate annotations cover selected 2011 balance-sheet value cells only and are text-layer-derived, visually checked, not independently click-annotated. Engine outputs are cached from the separately run v2 and v8 evaluations; exact render hashes, engine versions, settings and devices were checked before pooling. The composite is diagnostic, not eligible for primary engine selection or a production accuracy claim.

environment.cpu_peak_scope: whole evaluator process; run one engine per invocation for engine-specific comparison
